title: NASA Sun fact sheet: mean energy production 0.1925
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists mean energy production as 0.1925.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Mean energy production (10 -3 J/kg s) as 0.1925 for the Sun. Listed under bulk parameters, not under the model-center heading. The sheet does not say this is a laboratory measurement. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
